podcast.title: Mike Peters Death (2025) – Cancer Activist and Everest Base Camp Concert
podcast.body: Mike Peters, energetic frontman of Welsh band The Alarm, died in 2025. A multiple cancer survivor, he founded the Love Hope Strength Foundation for cancer research and patient support. In 2007 he led an expedition to Everest Base Camp for the highest-altitude concert ever performed on land, raising cancer research funds. "In 2007, he led an expedition to Everest Base Camp for the concert at the highest altitude ever performed on land."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Grizzled Veteran Participant
podcast.body: The Alarm, a Welsh band whose origins trace back to the mid-1970s, was one of the "grizzled veterans" who participated in the Warped Tour. "The alarm, the Welsh band, who's would go back to the middle of the 70s."

xref.title: Sting Operation and Arrest Details
xref.body: During the sting operation, Tim Lambesis met with an undercover detective. He provided the detective with a thousand dollars in cash, photographs of his wife, her home address, and the alarm codes for her house. He was arrested immediately after handing over the envelope in the parking lot of a Barnes and Noble bookstore. "As soon as he handed over the envelope in the parking lot of a Barnes and Noble bookstore, he was arrested."
